university.name: De Montfort University
university.summary: A UK university based in Leicester, offering undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses in technology, business, law, arts and health. International applicants can start in September or October, with some courses also recruiting in January, February or April.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: Three years full-time, four years with a placement
courses.overview: A three-year undergraduate degree covering programming, databases, operating systems and networks, with an optional placement year that extends the course to four years.
courses.academic_requirements: UCAS typical offer 112 points; A Level BBC; BTEC Extended Diploma DMM; T Levels Merit; Access to HE Pass with 30 Level 3 credits at Merit; IB 26; five GCSEs at grade 4/C or above including English and Maths. Other equivalent and international qualifications are recognised.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each band (or equivalent) when starting the course.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The DMU Pakistan entry for undergraduate study states: Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) with 70% or above, plus either one year (new scheme) or two years (old scheme) of a BCom, BSc or BA with 60%. Entry to year 2 or 3 may be possible with course details, grades and syllabus supplied.
courses.career_notes: Roles listed on the course page include software developer, software engineer, systems engineer, database manager and web developer.
courses.application_deadline_note: No deadline is stated on the course page, which directs applicants to apply through UCAS.
courses.notes: The page gives September as the start without an international intake year. Pakistan route fields left null because the published undergraduate requirement combines HSC with part of a degree and is not a single route. Year 1 module list is not labelled compulsory or optional on the page.

courses.title: Cyber Security
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's in six blocks covering cyber security foundations, threat intelligence, malware analysis, penetration testing and digital forensics, finishing with a postgraduate project. The page states the course is NCSC-certified.
highlights: Foundation of Cyber Security and Engineering (indicative)
Cyber Threat Intelligence and Network Security (indicative)
Malware Analysis, Penetration Testing and Incident Response (indicative)
Digital Forensics with Legal, Ethical and Research Methods (indicative)
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree at 2:2 or above in a relevant subject, such as Computer Science, Computer Security, Informatics, Electrical and Communication Engineering, Cyber Security or Software Engineering. Applicants without formal qualifications but with extensive industry experience are considered individually.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each band (or equivalent) at the start of the course.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The DMU Pakistan entry for taught postgraduate study states: for a 2.2 classification, a four-year bachelor's degree from a recognised university with 55% or a GPA of 2.5/4; for a 2.1 classification, 65% or a GPA of 2.6/4. Some courses have extra requirements.
courses.career_notes: The page lists cyber security specialist roles in law enforcement, government, commercial IT departments and security consultancies. An optional work placement is available, with country restrictions.
courses.application_deadline_note: No application deadline is stated on the course page.
courses.notes: Page lists January and September intakes without years. Pakistan figures are the 2.2 level (55% or GPA 2.5/4); the 2.1 level is 65% or GPA 2.6/4 as published. The module list is marked indicative and not labelled compulsory or optional. Course degree-subject restriction (relevant subject) applies.

courses.title: International Business Management
courses.duration_text: 12 months (October start); 16 months (February and April starts)
courses.overview: A full-time taught master's in international management, built from six blocks that include strategy, critical management studies and a choice of dissertation, consulting project or business project simulator.
highlights: Innovation and Technology Management or Operations and Supply Chain Management (choose one)
Dissertation, Consulting Project or Business Project Simulator (choose one)
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree in any subject with a minimum 2:2, or an equivalent overseas or professional qualification.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each band (or equivalent) at the start of the course.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The DMU Pakistan entry for taught postgraduate study states: for a 2.2 classification, a four-year bachelor's degree from a recognised university with 55% or a GPA of 2.5/4; for a 2.1 classification, 65% or a GPA of 2.6/4. Some courses have extra requirements.
courses.career_notes: The page refers to guaranteed work experience opportunities through the DMU Careers Team and the DMU Global international experience programme.
courses.application_deadline_note: No application deadline is stated on the course page.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: latest published fee is GBP 19,000 for 2026/27 (page also shows GBP 18,450 for 2025/26). Page shows programme codes labelled September and January while the intake text says October, February and April; intakes recorded as the text states, without years.

scholarships.name: Global Access Scholarship (undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 per year of study, irrespective of point of entry
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee reduction for international students joining a full-time undergraduate degree. It is awarded automatically when the deposit is paid before the deadline, and applies for up to three years of study.
scholarships.criteria_text: International students joining a full-time undergraduate degree who pay overseas fees and are self-funded; sponsored students are not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: Awarded on paying the deposit before the deadline; no date is given on the page.
scholarships.notes: Published terms cover 2026/27 entry only; 2027/28 terms not yet published. Extra GBP 500 Full Fee Scholarship available for paying full first-year fees before the deposit deadline. Exclusions (pathway progressors, repeat years, foundation) are on https://www.dmu.ac.uk/international/en/fees-and-scholarships/terms-and-conditions.aspx.

scholarships.name: Global Access Scholarship (postgraduate taught)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 fee deduction for one year of study (GBP 3,500 for the Global MBA)
scholarships.summary: A tuition fee deduction for international students joining a full-time taught postgraduate degree. It applies to a single year of study and is awarded automatically when the deposit is paid before the deadline.
scholarships.criteria_text: International students joining a full-time postgraduate taught degree who pay overseas fees and are self-funded; sponsored students are not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: Awarded on paying the deposit before the deadline; no date is given on the page.
scholarships.notes: Published terms cover 2026/27 entry only; 2027/28 terms not yet published. Extra GBP 500 Full Fee Scholarship available for paying full first-year fees before the deposit deadline. Not available to PhD, MPhil, DBA or pathway progressors per the terms page.
